name: Blood-Maddened Banishment
text: Use in a Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets, when one of your BLOODLETTERS units is a target. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit is destroyed before the unit has fought, roll a D6: on a 4+ it is not removed yet, and once the enemy unit finishes its attacks it fights, then is removed.

name: Empyric Predators
text: Use in your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, picking one of your FLESH HOUNDS units within 6 inches of it that has not fired Overwatch this phase. Your unit makes a Normal move of up to 6 inches. Until the end of the phase it cannot be picked to Fire Overwatch.

name: Manifest Hate
text: Use in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets, when one of your LEGIONES DAEMONICA units is a target. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
